thread:
elaine (PM): Quick sync — draft playbook for granular A/B candidate selection for routing experiments. Goal: safe, measurable, customer-friendly rollouts that let us test model variants without surprising latency/cost. I sketched stages + guardrails, want cross-team take. TL;DR: shadow parity -> micro-canary -> regional ramp -> tenant opt-ins -> automated rollback. Thoughts?

sam (SRE): +1. Important to codify SLO gates. Proposed canary gating: p95 latency < 300ms AND error-rate < 0.1% for the canary window. Stages: 1% -> 5% -> 20% with health checks every 15m. If any check fails, auto-roll back to baseline.

nidhi (Eng): For flags I recommend dual-flag pattern: routing flag + telemetry sampling flag. Also per-tenant override (opt-in). Example flag names: `rollout.routing.cohort.v2` and `rollout.routing.cohort.v2.telemetry`. Keep flag decay plan (auto-disable after 30d unless promoted).

maria (DevEx): Telemetry hooks: tag every request with `candidate`, `cohort`, `control_pct`, `tenant_opt_in`. Add a small eval pipeline that runs a sampled set of production prompts through both control/candidate to compute embedding-similarity + basic heuristics. Fail if quality delta > 3% for the configured metric.

ryan (Product Eng): We have 3 pilot customers asking for early opt-in. Suggest exposing `tenant_opt_in` toggle in Console + a whitelist in the flag service. For pilot, require explicit contract and a 24h bake window before they route >10% of their traffic.

priya (Security): For Private deployments ensure telemetry exports are tenant-scoped and prompts are redacted before leaving customer VPC. Also require KMS key binding for any exported artifacts. No cross-tenant sampling.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-route/v2 -> ticket #INTERNAL-4821. Rolling 1% sample to canary slice in us-west-2.

elaine (PM): Draft rollout checklist I'm proposing: 1) Preflight shadow for 72h (metric parity + regression checks) 2) Micro-canary (1% global, 1h) 3) Step-up to 5% (12h) -> 20% (72h) if all gates clear 4) Regional ramps (EU/APAC) with local SLO checks 5) Customer opt-ins (tenant-level whitelist) 6) Promote or rollback. Kill conditions: p95 latency regression > 20% absolute or relative, error-rate increase > 0.1ppt, quality metric drop > 3%. If any trigger, immediate rollback and postmortem.

sam (SRE): Additions: automated rollback must complete within 2 mins of detection. We'll own the runbook and the PagerDuty escalation. Also include a short-circuit that routes all traffic to a cheaper fallback model if capacity strains.

nidhi (Eng): Quick config snippet for flag service (example):
```json
{
  "flag": "rollout.routing.cohort.v2",
  "stages": [
    {"pct": 1, "duration": "1h"},
    {"pct": 5, "duration": "12h"},
    {"pct": 20, "duration": "72h"}
  ],
  "guards": {"latency_p95_ms": 300, "error_rate_pct": 0.1}
}
```
Use this as a canonical template in the PRD.

maria (DevEx): I'll add dashboard names and panels (rollout.summary, rollout.latency_p95_by_cohort, rollout.quality_delta). Also add a small sample-set called `prod-smoke-v2` for automated quality checks.

ryan (Product Eng): Can we make the cohort-selection deterministic per-tenant+user-id hashing so we don't split sessions? Also plan for cookie-based stickiness for web clients.

sam (SRE): Yes to hashing + stickiness. Also note: when we do regional ramps, make sure we mind regional capacity ceilings (we'll annotate ceilings in the rollout ticket).

elaine (PM): Next steps: Nidhi to draft the roll-forward PR for flag config + runbook, Maria to wire dashboard and eval pipeline, Sam to finalize SRE thresholds and runbook snippets, Priya to confirm telemetry redaction plan, Ryan to coordinate pilot customers. I'll schedule a 30m shiproom tomorrow to sign off. Sound good? :thumbsup: 

nidhi (Eng): Sounds good. I'll include a short CLI snippet for testing locally: `redwood flag set rollout.routing.cohort.v2 --pct 1 --dry-run` and a unit test harness that validates guard evaluation.

maria (DevEx): I'll also add a one-page runbook section for on-call to run through quick rollback steps and confirm dashboards.

ryan (Product Eng): I'll message the pilot customers and get opt-in confirmations, will add them to the whitelist once they're signed.

priya (Security): I'll share a short checklist for KMS + redaction that CI must pass before telemetry export is enabled.

elaine (PM): Thanks everyone — please drop any final comments in the PR and I'll merge once SRE + Security sign off.
